headline: Committee recommends adopting water system purchase resolution on 7-1 vote

meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.summary: The vote was seven to one with one member excused. The council chair had wanted to hear from the Board of Water Supply first. The resolution goes to the full council; the PUC must approve the sale, and closing is projected by April next year.
meeting.recap: A consultant who appraised the systems said, as far as they knew, there were no encumbrances (legal claims) on them.[[0:17:42]] An engineer who inspected the systems said they saw no leaks above normal.[[0:20:13]] The administration said current customer fees bring in more money than it costs to run the systems.[[0:23:54]] The PUC must approve the sale.[[0:25:50]] One reservoir has no fence; adding one is listed as a post-closing obligation (a task after the sale).[[0:33:29]] The administration said it would add fire hydrants where needed after the purchase.[[0:35:30]] The council chair declined to support the resolution yet, wanting to hear from the Board of Water Supply first.[[0:43:25]] The administration said sending the item to that board could push council action to October or later.[[0:55:55]] Closing on the purchase is projected by April next year.[[0:58:17]] The committee voted seven to one, with one member excused, to recommend adopting the resolution.[[1:09:27]] The recording ends as the committee takes a 10-minute break.[[1:10:46]]
meeting.next: The resolution now goes to the full council. The council chair said their vote could change at the council meeting.
